_instructions: The shop catalogue. /shop lists everything; each item also gets its own page at /shop/<id>. `category` groups items. `price: null` renders 'Ask us' rather than a number we invented. Add an item here and both the listing and its page appear on the next build.
_note_on_pricing: PRICES MISSING for every branded/merch item — Matt has not supplied them. They render 'Ask us' and are excluded from the system builder until a price exists. Do not guess these.
